title: [Runner] GetAllConflicts returns phantom system conflict when none exists
author: crutkas
summary: The General report describes bug GetAllConflicts() returns synthetic System conflict entry even with no actual conflict. Found by AI test review fleet.

proposed_fixes.title: Return system conflicts only when a real system reservation exists
proposed_fixes.root_cause: GetAllConflicts appears to add a synthetic System conflict entry even when no registered shortcut or operating-system reservation conflicts with the selected keys.
plan: Trace conflict aggregation in the runner and identify where the synthetic System entry is appended.
Gate that entry on an actual system-conflict result instead of adding it unconditionally.
Add focused tests for no-conflict, module-conflict, and genuine system-conflict cases.
verification: Use an unused shortcut and confirm that no System row appears, then verify known reserved shortcuts still report the System conflict.

confidence.rationale: The maintainer-authored report names the exact API and observed invariant violation, making the likely correction narrow and testable.
